body:
## CAST v3 vocab-expansion RUN — honest receipt (R2 run of sealed spec #8 / ba16548)

**Verdict: FAIL** per sealed R8 kill criterion. No goalpost moves; v1/v2 FAIL receipts stand.

### Gates (all measured in one run, v2 baseline re-measured same-run and matches published v2 receipt exactly)
- **H1 recover >=3/4 zero-evidence failures: PASS — 4/4.** wc05 blok print texture -> woodcut (L2), sf10 cottoo-wnol atmohpsere -> soft (L3), hr08 hrad -> harsh (L1), un07 brutalist razor edge contrast -> harsh (L4). Degraded CAST suite: **58/58, zero failures** (v2: 55/58).
- **H2 clean 50/50 + per-class deltas <=0.1: FAIL.** Clean top-1 = 50/50, but clean sf10 prompt literally is `cotton-wool atmosphere` (metaphor probe): L4's weak atmosphere (+1.0 soft) violates the sealed <=0.1 delta gate. This is the intended feature colliding with the sealed anti-drift gate.
- **H3 no over-firing: PASS** (mean cand 0.98 == v2 baseline).
- **Kill: fallback fires degraded 5 <= 18: PASS** (v2: 9; fewer because real hits now exist).
- **H4 parity 7/7: PASS** (tools/nl_parity.mjs @ edge-worker-graph-port via worktree; canonical edge/nl_route.js + core untouched).

### FAIL-first
`tools/cast_v3_pins.js` (11 pins: L1 transposition pair, L2 constituent + order/60% guards, L3 hyphen split, L4 vocab/weight): all RED on pre-v3 tree (buildV3 undefined, crash) -> 11/11 green post-implementation.

### Spec correction (recorded in receipt, not a goalpost move)
sf10's `atmohpsere` vs `atmosphere` is a 3-letter rotation (OSA distance 2), not the single adjacent swap the spec table implied. L1 threshold is sealed at 1; sf10 recovery rides on the cotton-wool L3 match. L4 still adds atmosphere to vocab per the sealed closed list.

### Consequence per sealed R8
Clean-suite score-delta FAIL -> **v3 layers are NOT merged into canonical**. The decision (gate exemption for L4 vocab on literal-term prompts, or L4 restricted to degraded-context activation) belongs to a v4 spec with a fresh unseen set — owed per this spec's honest-limits section.

Stacked on #8 (cast-vocab-v3-spec). Supersedes nothing; v2 remains the live behavior.
title: CAST v3 RUN receipt: H1 4/4 recovered, H2 FAIL on sealed delta gate — verdict FAIL (R2 of sealed spec)
